column1: # Mass-name cluster B: Nameplate (14/15 pkgs; util.nameplate done by namesA), Nameplate2* families (31), Gui2Extension (21/22; util.rewindhandlers done by namesA), GuiExtension (5), framework/nameplate leftovers (15)

column5: evidence

loads GeckoLib animation JSON per ResourceLocation: method1 builds AnimationCache, method3 reads the resource stream (Sentry attachment literally "animation-file-loader.json"); used by FogIterator/ModelGeometryLoader
conversation group-icon / chat-image upload pipeline: file picker (Gui4), 5 MiB limit, MimeTypeUtils, GetUploadUrls + presigned PUT, posts "conversation:iconUpload"/"chatImagesUploaded" JS events
@FunctionalInterface void accept(T, int) bound to DriverComponent.method17(int) (char typed) via ComponentStyleData.method26, alongside the sibling Component*Callback interfaces
static draw of a string/Component at x,y with NORMAL/SHADOW/BORDER (Type); used by Holograms3_2, MapRoomRenderer, Holograms4Updater

MixinCore9Extension decorator: method4(boolean)/method30() gate rendering on IslandUtils + "hide on other islands" option; factory method4(MixinCore9Extension) used by dozens of HUD mods as Nameplate.method4(new X.Data())
holds List<EventSubscription<Highlight>>, register()/unregister() every consumer with its priority on the LunarEventBus; siblings DynamicListenerEvent/ThreadedEvent
Framework3 decorator with a locked flag (initially true): isEnabled/method3 report false and load() buffers the value until unlock() applies it; debug mods wrap Framework3.method6(default) with it
method1 sorts MorphRenderer holograms by distance and batches them per HologramsType (PARTICLE/BLOCK) with lightmap toggle; method2 decomposes a Matrix3f into scale+Tait-Bryan angles
K/V store interface with get/put/remove/method7 that applies changes inside UndoRedoManager transactions; implemented by LinkedHashMapImpl/TreeMapImpl/TransactionalSet
ZIP central-directory parser: method1(FileChannel, name) walks EOCD/ZIP64 records to return ZipEntryLocation(dataOffset, size); used by RewindFileReader for "packets.dat"
static Map<Integer,List<Class<? extends ReplayPacket>>>: method1 class->index of the packet id, method2 id+index -> newInstance; id 0 registers every recorded packet class

per-layer mod (Fishing2Iterator) maps keyed by type: method2 rotates "applied" into "previously applied", cleanup() tears down entries absent from the new set; Lombok toString is literally "LayerPropertiesContext(...)"
immutable ByteBuffer + width + height frame handed to the ffmpeg pipeline (RewindRenderQueue -> FFmpegRenderer.method2)
static factories wrapping a raw packet into a clientbound EventPacket: method1 uses CONFIGURATION, method2 uses PLAY; used by the capture/recorder classes
KeybindAction + boolean state; applies into ReplayContext.method15() keybind map and method4 returns the inverted packet; recorded by KeybindRecorder
ReplayEnvironment + value string; replay sets ReplayContext.method30(new ReplayLocation(env,value)); recorded by LocationRecorder
tick-only packet with empty replay handler; RewindHandlers.method23 uses getTick() to seek and InputTimelinePanel splits the stream into per-tick segments (marker)
no payload; method3 calls ReplayContext.method36(-1) clearing the state-refresh target tick; emitted last by RewindRecorder.method2 after all RecorderCapture snapshots
empty read/write and empty replay handler; used as the no-op inverse packet (e.g. returned by gui/Nameplate2Impl2.method4) and by RewindFileReader
tick value replayed onto Player.bridge$setAttackStrengthTicker (and itemSwapTicker on MC>=35); recorded by PlayerStateRecorder
byte[] serialized chat message-signature cache; replay calls NetHandlerPlayClient.bridge$deserializeMessageSignatureCache (MC>=15); recorded by MessageSignatureRecorder

protobuf Any bytes: replayed via AssetServerClient.method2, or FogHandler2.method18 for Override/ConfigurableSettings; recorded from RewindRecorder.method1 (ApolloSettingsCapture and asset-server websocket messages)
JSON string deserialized to HypixelLocation and pushed to HypixelLocationListener; recorded by ScoreboardRecorder
boolean payload; emitted first by RewindRecorder.method2 before every RecorderCapture, sets ReplayContext.method36(current tick) as the state-refresh target when flagged
clears the replay GUI screen (GuiScreenContext.method1(null)); inverse method4 reopens the stored screen
position/block fields; replay calls PlayerController.bridge$useItemOn; recorded by PlayerStateRecorder
paused boolean replayed into ReplayContext.method33(paused); method4 returns the inverted packet; recorded by PlayerStateRecorder
feature id + Gui2Extension2 (HUD anchor) + x/y; replay calls MixinCore9Extension.method27(anchor)/method17(x,y) on the mod named by the id
UUID + boolean; method3 calls RewindFileReader.method8(uuid) which switches to "snapshots/<uuid>/packets.dat" and loads mods.json
MouseInputType CLICK/RELEASE/DRAG/SCROLL with coords and modifiers; replayed through GuiScreenContext alignment mapping into bridge$mouseClicked/Released/ClickMove/Scrolled
sprinting boolean replayed onto Player.bridge$setSprinting; recorded by PlayerStateRecorder
packet id + byte[] + PacketDirectionBridge + BridgeType2_2; replay rebuilds and handles the raw packet; recorded/described by PacketRecorder (name()/data() debug strings)
Type.DISCONNECT -> EventDisconnect.method2(true); recorded by RewindRecorder.method6 on EventDisconnect
no payload; method3 calls RewindHandlers.method14() which clears the level and chat and re-creates the local session; emitted on resume
two GuiType values set GuiScreenContext.method17/18 (x/y anchoring used to map recorded mouse coords)
no payload; replay calls PlayerController.bridge$attack(); recorded by PlayerStateRecorder
double delta replayed as EventMouseWheel on the event bus; method4 returns the negated packet; recorded from the EventMouseWheel handler
message string replayed via Screen.bridge$openChat(message); recorded from GuiStateRecorder
EventUseItem slot; replay calls PlayerController.bridge$useItem(slot); recorded by PlayerStateRecorder
feature id + Type FORCE_ENABLED/FORCE_DISABLED/NONE; method3 applies SettingIntercept from OverrideSource.SERVER to the named mod
creative-tab index; replay calls bridge$setCreativeTab and opens the inventory; recorded from GuiStateRecorder
no payload; replay calls Screen.bridge$pickBlock(); recorded from EventPickBlock
@FunctionalInterface provide(CommandArguments, Nameplate3_2) called by ArgumentCommandNode/CommandArgumentParser and CommandCompleter to collect tab suggestions
DynamicCategory listing online players as SettingOptions keyed RewindSettingKeys("player", uuid); instantiated for the "entityOverrides" category
DriverGuiExtension registered as the "rewindInteraction" JS provider; callbacks setAsCameraTarget/hide/nametag/skin write rewind setting overrides for the selected entity
option "listMode"/"mode": VERTICAL("vertical")/HORIZONTAL("horizontal") selecting the armor-status list layout (Armorstatus.field19, ArmorStatusPanelRenderer)
chat-message categories ISLAND_VISITOR/ALL/PARTY/GUILD/GUILD_OFFICER/DM_RECEIVE/DM_SEND/COOP with command + Rewindhandlers.Extension class + id; filters which chats a fishing command records
option "textSide": ABOVE/LEFT/RIGHT/BELOW placement of a HighlightButton hover text (HighlightSerializer/HighlightButton)
option "HeadBorderStyle": NONE/SINGLE_COLOR/CLASS_COLORS border colouring of map player heads (BettermapSettings.field38)
option "secretRoutesPathType": PARTICLES/LINE/ARROW/LINE_DASHED/ARROW_DASHED/NONE (ids routeRenderType*), SecretRoutePath setting of SkyblockDungeonRoutes
option "skyblockContainerOverlayPreview": ALWAYS/RECENT(60s)/NEVER gating the container-overlay preview in NameplateComponent.method15
option "raffleTaskFilter": ALL/EASY/MEDIUM/HARD (+RaffleTaskDifficulty) used by SkyblockRaffleTasksHud
option "boxMode"/"dungeonWaypointBoxMode": FULL("fullBlock")/HITBOX("blockHitbox") waypoint hitbox style (DungeonWaypointManager)
option "rounding": NEAREST/1Decimal/2Decimal/3Decimal DecimalFormats used by Momentum.format
option "potionCounter": POTION/SOUP counting mode of mod.combat.PotionCounter
option "timePeriod": SESSION/DAY/WEEK/MONTH/YEAR/ALL_TIME stat window of PvpInfo
option "colorMode": OVERLAY/RECOLOR for ParticleChildMod (referenced from the jar-built ParticleChanger); the only file in feature.render
THIRD("thirdPerson",1)/FORWARD("forward",2) selecting the snaplook camera perspective (mod.movement.Snaplook)
option "tierSource": PVPTIERS_COM/MCTIERS_COM/SUBTIERS/TIERTESTS/PVPHQ each carrying its Tiertagger2_2 provider + name Codec
option "shownStatistic": TIER/RANK deciding whether Tiertagger draws the tier badge or the rank
option "levelHeadSource": NETWORK/BEDWARS/SKYWARS level-head data sources with query param and random nick-level range (HypixelMod.field23)
option "shadowRecordingTime": thirtySixtySeconds/oneTwoMinute/twoFourMinutes/fiveTenMinutes -> ms used by ReplayHandlerImpl.method1 (clip < 300000ms) and KeyframeRecorder
option "channels": MONO/STEREO for the exported replay audio (ExportSettingsPanel.field20)
option "videoResolution": 720p/1080p/1440p/4k/CUSTOM with width+height (GuiIterator.field7)
option "follow": POSITION("positionOnly")/POS_ROT_BODY/POS_ROT_HEAD camera tracking detail (RewindHandlers3Updater.field12, RewindhandlersImpl)
export container MP4/MKV/MOV/AVI/WEBP/WEBM with audio support + allowed VideoCodecs (RewindhandlersNameplate.field1)
the "data_provider" trait (OptionTraits.field10): Gui + JsonProvider that serializes an option for the settings UI; implemented by OptionJsonProvider, default methods add child categories
abstract DriverGuiExtension holding LinkedHashMap<String,Gui2Task> (Gui2Task.toString leaks "ButtonProvider"): method1(task) registers, click-by-id runs task.method11()
@CallbackJS provider (setMap/sendButtonPress/sendMapPress/settings/showMap/setDefault) for the Spirit Leap map: floor + player list JSON with Lunar Plus colours
@CallbackJS provider (createWaypointGroup/delete/update/set) writing GuiHandler/Loader waypoint groups through Client mods
@CallbackJS("upload") provider that shares a screenshot via ScreenshotShareThread/AssetServerClient with a progress iterator

SettingIntercept<Framework7Extension,Boolean>: EnumMap<OverrideSource,SettingOverride<Boolean>> with CLIENT_CRITERIA predicates, broadcasts to the Apollo ModSettingModule and rewrites child options; instantiated by KeystrokeKey as the "intercept" trait
ModCategories impl wrapping Set.of(RewindhandlersType...): returns the categories a feature belongs to; the factory impl of ModCategories.method2/3

Framework8 + Translatable base details: language path "<id>.details", translated name/description/info, categories/aliases/authors, isVanilla/allowsKeybind; DynamicFeatureDetails extends it (Lombok toString leaks the old name only)
ChildModBinding impl: parent Framework7Extension + optional BooleanSupplier visibility; the concrete binding created by ChildModBinding.method3/4/5
tab-suggestion accumulator interface over the input cursor: remaining text (method1), start index, add(String) and copy-with-start(int); implemented by Nameplate3Handler and consumed by RouteCommand
CommandSuggestionBuilder impl: holds input + start + List<String> of suggestions, add() skips duplicates of the remaining text, copy-with-start shares the list; built by CommandCompleter
Framework3 combining several LightingExtension<Boolean> options with AND/OR semantics; isEnabled walks the OptionCombiner, setEnabled is a no-op
Framework3 with no option (Optional.empty) and a fixed default: value restored by method2, mutable via setEnabled; used as a constant feature toggle
ModDisplay impl: thumbnail icon pair + name Supplier, draws the centered name, persists seen/lastModified/favorite; built by ModDisplay.method(data)
EnabledOption + JsonConfigurable: creates/overrides the "enabled" LightingExtension with a default value and sets it as default (priority 100)
CommandArguments singleton whose every getter throws "no argument values are parsed during tab-complete suggestion gathering"; passed to suggestion providers by CommandCompleter

ModLifecycle impl: tracks enabled state + DynamicCondition/ChildModBinding, registers/unregisters event listeners and GuiRewindhandlers, owns commands, child-mod lifecycle and on-enable/disable/once runnables
OptionContainer impl: LinkedHashSet of LightingExtension options, nested/child collection, predicate walk, rebuild from a feature, load/save("options") with priority 200
PageState impl: single mutable boolean with getter + fluent setter; built by PageState.method3
PanelPosition + JsonConfigurable: x/y floats, panelIndex and reset flag with load/save("panelIndex"); built by PanelPosition.method9
